data.title: BDMS to Host Annual Academic Conference 2026 on AI-Era Healthcare Innovation
data.description: Bangkok, August 27, 2026 – Bangkok Dusit Medical Services Public Company Limited (BDMS) is reaffirming its commitment to advancing medical and multidisciplinary excellence while promoting ongoing academic collaboration and knowledge exchange. The company will host the BDMS Academic Annual Meeting 2026 under the theme “Innovative Healthcare Across the Lifespan” from Nov 9-13, 2026, at the BDMS Connect Center, Wireless Road, Bangkok. Held in a hybrid format with onsite participation and online access via Zoom, the conference will broaden access to medical knowledge and provide a platform for healthcare professionals, academics, researchers, and interested participants nationwide to exchange ideas and experiences. Registration is open through October 20, 2026.

data.title: Thailand Real Estate Awards 2026 Celebrates 10 Years; AP Thailand Takes Top Honour
data.description: Thailand’s leading developers, projects and real estate leaders gathered at Four Seasons Hotel Bangkok at Chao Phraya River on 27 August for the Thailand Real Estate Awards 2026, an exclusive celebration of the very best of the country’s property industry and a landmark tenth anniversary for the awards.

data.title: Thailand Draws Foreign Patients for Aesthetic Care
data.description: Thailand’s non-invasive aesthetics sector isemergingas a regional growth force, with a distinctly Thai, diversity-led philosophy of beauty gaining ground alongside the established conventions of Korea and Japan.

data.title: Thailand Hosts Global Sanitation Leaders at World Toilet Summit 2026
data.description: The Asian Institute of Technology (AIT) and the World Toilet Organization (WTO) today announced that the World Toilet Summit 2026 will take place from 17 to 19 November 2026 at the AIT campus in Pathum Thani, Thailand, closing on 19 November, United Nations World Toilet Day. The summit marks the World Toilet Organization’s 25th anniversary.

data.title: Arkitektura wins prestigious Master Entrepreneur Award at APEA 2026
data.description: Another milestone for Arkitekturaon the Asia-Pacific stage, reflecting the strength of its leadership in driving the organisation forward under the philosophy “It’s all about quality,” while fostering sustainable growth and delivering value to customers,businessesand society.

data.title: Moonlight Silver Forum 2026 Introduces “The Next Benchmark”
data.description: Moonlight Bullion Refinery Co., Ltd. highlights a pivotal shift in the silver jewelry industry, as competition across the Global Jewelry Supply Chain moves beyond quality, pricing, and manufacturing capabilities toward “The Next Benchmark” — a new competitive landscape increasingly shaped by Responsible Sourcing, Traceability, Transparency, Certification, and Sustainability. In response to this transformation, the company is hosting “Moonlight Silver Forum 2026,” bringing together industry leaders and businesses to exchange perspectives, anticipate emerging standards, and strengthen their readiness to compete in an evolving global market.

data.title: ZTE and AIS Launch ZTE Day Thailand 2026 to Drive Intelligent Networks
data.description: ZTE and AIS launched ZTE Day Thailand 2026,showcasingintelligent network solutions to accelerate Thailand's smarter, more sustainable digital transformation

data.title: Pi Securities hosts AI-era investment seminar
data.description: Pi Private Wealth ,a part of Pi Securities Public Co Ltd (“Pi Securities”) , hosted the “Navigating Your Portfolio in the AI Era: 2H 2026”seminarunder the theme “How to Build an Investment Portfolio in the AI Era”. The event provided insights into the economic outlook and key investment strategiesfor the second half of 2026, with a particular focus on the opportunities and challenges arising from artificial intelligence, the digitaleconomy and related industries. The seminar also explored practical approaches to portfolio construction, asset allocationand risk diversification, equipping investors with strategies to navigate rapidly evolving market conditions and capture opportunities in the AI-driven investment landscape.

data.title: Double A reports Q2 2026 revenue of 5.33 billion baht and net profit of 267 million baht
data.description: Double A (1991) Public CompanyLimited (Double A)has announced its operating results for the second quarter of 2026, reporting total revenue of 5.334 billionbaht, an increase of 1.83% compared with the same period last year, and a net profit of 267 millionbaht. The results were driven by the company’s effective cost management and continuous adjustments to its production and logistics plans, which helped mitigate the impact of external pressures and ensure that products were delivered to customers as planned, amid the ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

data.title: JAI by ONESIAM presents “JAI Rising”
data.description: JAI by ONESIAM officially unveiled “JAI Rising: A Journey Like No Other,” marking a new chapter for a global invitation-only private members’ club. The launch brings together business founders, entrepreneurs, creators and next-generation leaders from diverse fields through a community that inspires new perspectives and meaningful connections.

data.title: Book Early, Stay Better at Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok
data.description: Bangkok, August 2026 – Planning ahead comes with more ways to enjoy your stay. With the “Book Early, Stay Better” offer at Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok, guests who book at least 30 days in advance can enjoy enhanced comfort, added flexibility and extra value throughout their stay.

data.title: STA Drives Growth with Highest Q2 Profit in 4 Years, Advances "Empowering AI" Mission
data.description: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited (STA), The world’s largest fully integrated natural rubber enterprise and Thailand’s leading rubber glove manufacture, reported a revenue of THB 31,003.8 million in Q2/2026, up 15.5%, and a net profit of THB 895 million, the highest in 4 years, representing 38.7% increase QoQ. For 6M/2026, the Company recorded revenue of THB 57,845.6 million, with a net profit of THB 1,540.4 million, returning to profit compared with the same period last year. This strong performance was supported by improved profitability across both its natural rubber and rubber glove businesses.

data.title: MoMo Café launch a new menu where global favorites meet truly thai classics
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – August 2026 – Courtyard by Marriott Bangkok introduces a new culinary chapter atMoMoCaféwith the launch of a refreshed all-day dining menu where Global Favorites meet Truly Thai Classics . Led by newly appointed Executive Chef Jack,UkritSangprapai , the new menu reflects evolving guest preferences through quality ingredients, authentic recipes, and familiar flavors designed to bring people together.

data.title: Medical Fair Asia 2026 brings Asia’s healthcare ecosystem together in Singapore
data.description: More than 1,000 exhibitors from 40 countries and regions will gather at Marina Bay Sands as Medical Fair Asia, Medical Manufacturing Asia and the inaugural RehaCare Asia connect medical innovation, manufacturing, healthcare delivery and rehabilitation in one regional platform.

data.title: Siam Music Yamaha & DPU Award 4-Year Full Scholarships to SNEAKER AGES 2026 Winners
data.description: Siam Music Yamaha Co., Ltd., under of Siam Motors Group and Dhurakij Pundit University (DPU), have officially signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). This partnership establishes a 2026 scholarship programme for musically gifted youth and provides public relations support for the premier Asian-level music contest "Siam Music Yamaha Presents, we are SNEAKER AGES Thailand Band Competition 2026".

data.title: Betagro names Tre Porapat as first 'Friend of Perfecta', boosting its premium pet food status.
data.description: Bangkok –August 26,2026 – BetagroPublic Company Limited (BTG), a leading integrated food company in Thailand, has announced actor Tre –PorapatSrikajorndechaas the first “Friend of Perfecta”. This partnership underscores Perfecta’s dedication to a new generation of premium pet parents and reinforces its “Caring with Heart” concept, which delivers superior, nutritious,high-qualityand fresh pet food to support theoptimalhealth of beloved companions.

data.title: MDES-depa celebrates success of coding Thailand 2026
data.description: The Ministry of Digital Economy and Society (MDES), through the Digital Economy Promotion Agency (depa), has announced the success of Coding Thailand 2026: AI Inspires the Future, a project aimed at promoting coding and artificial intelligence (AI) skills among Thai students and teachers nationwide. More than 12,000 students and teachers from across the country registered toparticipatein the project. After completing a series of learning activities and knowledge assessments, 3,224 participants from 806 teams were selected to take part in the regional competitions.

data.title: Shield Insurance Broker Wins Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand 2026
data.description: Shield Insurance Broker, operated by Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR), won the Best Customer Experience Initiative in Thailand under the Retail Finance Digital and Frictionless Awards category at The Asian Banker Thailand Awards 2026 . This reflects its success in transforming its role from an insurance broker into a Service Broker. The focus goes beyond selling policies to prioritizing relationship building and continuous customer care throughout the coverage journey. This ranges from pre-purchase consultation, sales, and 24-hour after-sales care, to claim coordination and status tracking. The service model integrates the Shield Insurance Broker Call Center 1501, where a team of experts is on standby 24/7 for emergency coordination, ensuring our customers truly experience peace of mind from purchase to claim."

data.title: MQDC Launches Mulberry Grove The Forestias, a Super Luxury Multi-Generational Condo
data.description: Magnolia Quality Development Corporation Limited (MQDC) has launched Mulberry Grove The Forestias Condominiums, a super luxury low-rise condominium development spanning over 16 rai within The Forestias. Construction is now complete, and the project is ready for occupancy. The development stands out for its expansive surrounding greenery and design approach that seamlessly integrates nature with urban living, under the concept of Nurturing Multi-Generational Living — creating a residence where every member of the family, across every generation, can live and thrive together.

data.title: TPC Thailand Office unveils 6 investment pillars for growth in the ‘Well-being Economy’
data.description: Bangkok, Aug 25, 2026 — TPC Thailand Office has outlined its business and investment direction under the theme “The Well-being Economy: A New Role for Business Beyond Sustainability,” highlighting an approach that connects business growth with positive impact and supports the transition towards a wellbeing economy through its Six Investment Pillars.

data.title: National Science and Technology Fair 2026 Opens a World of Innovation from 8 Countries
data.description: The National Science and Technology Fair 2026 is alive with excitement and discovery. In one area, a child wears a brainwave-sensing device and concentratesto sendcommands that make a robot move. Nearby, children build with LEGO, writecodeand learn to control robots themselves. Elsewhere, visitors can get hands-on with aviation technology, space science,agricultureand virtual reality.
